description: ClickPipes GCS and Pub/Sub sources take a GCP service account JSON key: ClickPipePostObjectStorageSource.serviceAccountKey and ClickPipePatchObjectStorageSource.serviceAccountKey ('Base64-encoded GCP service account JSON key') and ServiceAccount.serviceAccountFile ('Google Cloud service account JSON key file content, base64 encoded'). A service account key is a private key; none of the three carries a sensitive mark. Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-11).
